title: Is Indonesia wider than the US?
hook: Indonesia is a scatter of islands. Lay it over the US and measure it.

knows: that Indonesia is a country made of islands
roughly where the US and Indonesia are on a world map
doesNotKnow: how far Indonesia stretches end to end
that a shape can be moved across the globe without changing its size

misconception: Indonesia is a modest cluster of islands, a fraction of a big country's reach.
objective: The learner can say that Indonesia stretches further end to end than the contiguous US (about 15% on the lesson's outlines), because a country of islands spans the sea between them.
keyState: Indonesia has been moved onto the contiguous US and both rulers (longest span of each outline) are shown.

claims.text: On the lesson's outlines Indonesia measures about 5,320 km end to end.
claims.source: Longest great-circle distance between two vertices of the Natural Earth 1:110m 'Indonesia' feature (kit data), R = 6,371.0088 km: 5,322.7 km, from 5.48N 95.29E to 9.12S 141.03E. Computed in Demo.tsx longestSpan (the same function that draws the ruler); re-run by the builder in a scratch script. Matches the cm-geography brief (5,323 km). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Independent Node run on the kit's countries-110m.json: 5,322.7 km (141.03 E, 9.12 S to 95.29 E, 5.48 N).

claims.text: On the lesson's outlines the contiguous US (the 48 joined states) measures about 4,650 km coast to coast.
claims.source: Same method on the largest polygon of the 1:110m 'United States of America' feature (7.98 M km², the lower 48; excludes Alaska, Hawaii and islands): 4,648.1 km, from 44.81N 66.97W to 38.95N 123.73W. Demo.tsx lower48 + longestSpan. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Independent run: largest US polygon area 7.98 M km2; span 4,648.1 km (66.97 W, 44.81 N to 123.73 W, 38.95 N).

claims.text: Measured the same way, Indonesia is about 15% longer than the contiguous US.
claims.source: 5,322.7 / 4,648.1 = 1.145. Computed on the stage from c1 and c2. Published extents use other definitions (east-west extent, full-resolution coastlines) and differ; the lesson claims only its own measure. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): 5322.7/4648.1 = 1.145; the stage prints 15%.

claims.text: Moving a shape around the globe by a rotation keeps its true size and every distance inside it.
claims.source: Rotations of the sphere are isometries (they preserve great-circle distance and area). Demo.tsx moveTo composes d3 geoRotation only, the same construction as the kit's moveToLatitude. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Re-derived; no issue.

claims.text: The Equal Earth map shows true sizes (it is an equal-area projection).
claims.source: Šavrič, Patterson & Jenny (2018), The Equal Earth map projection, IJGIS 33(3). Stage label 'Equal Earth map (true sizes)'. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Savric, Patterson and Jenny 2019, IJGIS 33(3):454-465 (online 2018): Equal Earth is equal-area.

claims.text: Indonesia is a country made of islands, and its land area is far smaller than the contiguous US.
claims.source: Kit data: the 'Indonesia' feature is a MultiPolygon of 13 island polygons at 1:110m; geoArea gives about 1.83 M km² for Indonesia vs 7.98 M km² for the lower-48 polygon (builder scratch run). Published: Indonesia about 1.9 M km², contiguous US about 8.1 M km² (CIA World Factbook, from memory). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Independent run: Indonesia 1.83 M km2 (13 island polygons) vs 7.98 M km2; published about 1.9 vs about 8 M km2.

recall.question: A country is made of islands spread over a wide sea. Compared with a solid country of the same land area, its end-to-end reach is usually:
recall.why: Its reach includes the sea between the islands: Indonesia has under a quarter of the contiguous US's land but stretches about 15% further end to end.
